data.title: 阿尼斯 · 竞技场拉拉队胜利跃起加油
data.description: 前哨基地模拟战竞技场边，阿尼斯身着红白配色的亮眼拉拉队短裙。她高举双手的红色绒花彩球凌空跃起，短裙飘扬展露出充满活力的健康腰肢，活力四射地为大获全胜的指挥官振臂欢呼。
data.location: 前哨基地竞技演武场边缘
data.action: 高举拉拉花球跃起喝彩，灿烂呼喊
data.lighting: 体育馆聚光灯与开阔天窗自然光
data.promptProse: Leaping into the air with pom-poms held high on the arena sidelines, her pleated cheerleader skirt catches the breeze. Stadium lights sparkle across her bare waist as she cheers enthusiastically for the viewer.
data.animaCaption: She leaps high with pom-poms raised, shouting happily for the viewer.
